The '''floating cities of [[Dac/Legends|Calamari]]''' were huge [[City/Legends|metropolises]] that rested atop the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and extended deep below the waves. Those cities were home to both the amphibious [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]].
